intent: Read an existing record within the caller's workspace
allowed: Signed-in owner can retrieve their own record
forbidden: An anonymous caller has no access
A different signed-in user cannot read this record
conditions: The record exists and is associated with the caller
relationships: record.workspace_id must belong to the authenticated caller
effects: The request does not modify record state
observables: An owner gets 200 and their record
Foreign and absent IDs have indistinguishable 404 bodies
failure_modes: Missing records and forbidden records must not expose the reason

stories.given: A record exists in Alice's workspace
evidence: HTTP response status and JSON record ID

stories.given: Alice has a record, Bob does not own it, and an absent record ID is available
stories.when: Bob fetches both Alice's and absent record IDs
then: Sanitized responses do not disclose record existence or owner data
evidence: HTTP statuses and normalized response bodies

intent: Submit an asynchronous job and receive a reference
allowed: Signed-in users may submit valid jobs
forbidden: Anonymous users may not submit jobs
conditions: A valid job payload is provided
relationships: Job is assigned to the submitting workspace
effects: Exactly one queued job is persisted for a successful request
observables: Created job state is queued in test-owned storage
failure_modes: Malformed payload rejected without persistent side effects

stories.given: Valid job payload and an isolated queue
then: One job owned by this workspace enters queued state

stories.given: An invalid payload and a snapshot of owned job state
stories.when: The user submits the invalid job
evidence: HTTP status and comparison of test-owned job IDs
